#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int numOfDifLet(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
    int first = (b < a) ? b : a - 1;
    int last = a - 1;
    
    string sb;
    char ch = 'a';
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(ch);
        ch++;
    }
    ch = (l < a) ? sb[last] : sb[first];
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(ch);
    }
    
    vector<bool> used(26, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        used[sb[sb.length() - i - 1] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    int ptr = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        while (used[ptr]) ptr++;
        sb.push_back('a' + ptr);
        used[ptr] = true;
    }
    
    ch = sb[min(b, a - 1) + a + b];
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(ch);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < a + b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(sb[i]);
    }
    
    bool used2[26] = {false};
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        used2[sb[i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        if (used2[i]) ans++;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l--; r--;
    
    int len = a + b;
    int dif = r - l;
    int ans;
    if (dif >= 2 * len) {
        ans = max(a + 1, 2 * a - b);
    } else {
        r -= len * (l / len);
        l %= len;
        ans = numOfDifLet(a, b, l, r);
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
